summary: Iteration 32 - Comprehensive testing of AdminPage refactoring (UserCreateDialog, UserImportDialog, UserEditDialog extracted), server.py modularization (settings.py router), conference scheduling with email invites, thread support in chat, and presence improvements. All 30 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 32 features verified working: (1) AdminPage refactored to 319 lines with UserCreateDialog, UserImportDialog, UserEditDialog, BadgePrintView extracted to /components/admin/. (2) server.py modularized with settings.py router handling /api/currencies, /api/global-settings, /api/app-settings, /api/gdpr/settings, /api/financial-apis, /api/inventory/alerts. (3) Conference scheduling dialog with title, datetime, duration, participants, external emails, password, video, calendar event, email invites options. (4) Thread support working - messages show thread count indicator, clicking opens thread panel on right side with original message + replies. (5) Presence API working with heartbeat every 30s.

admin_page_refactoring.details: AdminPage.jsx reduced from 1037 to 319 lines. UserCreateDialog, UserImportDialog, UserEditDialog, BadgePrintView all extracted to /components/admin/. All admin features working: create user, edit profile (4 tabs: Profile, Account, Flags, Documents), import, badge print, reset password, bulk actions

server_modularization.details: settings.py router handles /api/currencies (14 currencies), /api/global-settings, /api/app-settings, /api/gdpr/settings, /api/financial-apis, /api/inventory/alerts. All endpoints accessible and working

conference_scheduling.details: Schedule Conference button in CommsPage header (staff+ roles only). Dialog with title, datetime, duration, participants, external emails, password, video enabled, calendar event, email invites options. Backend creates conference with meeting_code and join_link

thread_support.details: Messages show thread count indicator (e.g., '2 replies'). Clicking opens thread panel on right side with original message + replies. Thread input and send button working. Backend supports thread_id param in GET messages and POST messages

conference_email_invites.details: Backend conferences router sends email invites to internal users and external emails when creating a conference. Uses notifications system (gracefully falls back with warning log if Resend not configured)

presence_improvements.details: Presence heartbeat every 30s. Status selector (Available, Away, Do Not Disturb, Offline). Online count indicator. WebSocket broadcasts presence changes

chat_api_thread_support.details: /api/chat/conversations/{id}/messages supports thread_id query param. POST messages support thread_id field in body. Top-level messages include thread_count

login_flow.details: Login with admin@5812uganda.org / Admin@5812 working correctly
